items.information: ## Welcome to the gateway KLIA2 Cube Open 2025! [![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/gatewayKLIA2CubeOpen2025) ​ ## 📌 All participants will receive perks such as a T-shirt, an exclusive gift, a certificate of participation, a name tag, and a lanyard 📌 **If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Updates & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/gatewayKLIA2CubeOpen2025#57102-updates-announcements) and the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/gatewayKLIA2CubeOpen2025#57104-new-competitors) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.** ​ Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. ​ ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.information: **Important Information for Participants**: **Location**: The competition will take place on the 5th floor of the Centre Square Mall. **Arrival Time**: Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering**: All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants**: If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement**: First-time participants are required to bring a scanned copy of their ID card. Please ensure you have this with you. **Cube Requirement**: Participants must bring their own cubes. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants**: If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit both a physical and photo copy of your ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
